# MDL307 · `spaces-around-equals`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

Spaces around `=`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | values |
| Default severity | info |
| Fix | safe |
| Design references | K8, K9 |

## Why

GLib ignores spaces before `=` and at the start of the value, so `threads = 4` works. Writing `threads=4` keeps files uniform and makes trailing spaces (MDL302), which GLib does keep, easier to spot.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads = 4
outputdir	=/backup
logfile= /tmp/x
```

```text
2:8-2:11 info MDL307[spaces-around-equals] spaces around `=`
  fix (safe): Remove the spaces
3:10-3:12 info MDL307[spaces-around-equals] spaces around `=`
  fix (safe): Remove the spaces
4:8-4:10 info MDL307[spaces-around-equals] spaces around `=`
  fix (safe): Remove the spaces
```

✅ After `mydumper-lint check --fix`:

```ini
[mydumper]
threads=4
outputdir=/backup
logfile=/tmp/x
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL307: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL307` on the line above it.
